family_rule: AT_MOST_ONE_HORIZON_MAY_BE_FROZEN_FOR_FUTURE_TEST; AMONG PASSING HORIZONS CHOOSE HIGHER DEV_B_MEAN_KNOWN_NET_BPS, EXACT TIE CHOOSES SHORTER_HORIZON

features.name: hl_depth_imbalance_top5
features.rule: latest causal L2 snapshot <= decision, age <=2s; require >=5 BID and >=5 ASK levels; (sum_bid_size_0_4-sum_ask_size_0_4)/(sum_bid_size_0_4+sum_ask_size_0_4)

features.name: hl_aggressive_trade_flow_5s
features.rule: trades with decision-5s < recv_mono <= decision; B native side = aggressing BUY, A = aggressing SELL; (buy_size-sell_size)/(buy_size+sell_size); no trades => missing

features.name: binance_aggressive_trade_flow_5s
features.rule: reference trades with decision-5s < recv_mono <= decision; normalized BUY/SELL aggressor side; (buy_size-sell_size)/(buy_size+sell_size); no trades => missing

features.name: hl_mid_return_5s_bps
features.rule: 10000*(current primary BBO mid/anchor primary BBO mid-1); latest-at-or-before current and decision-5s anchors, each <=2s stale

features.name: binance_mid_return_5s_bps
features.rule: 10000*(current reference BBO mid/anchor reference BBO mid-1); latest-at-or-before current and decision-5s anchors, each <=2s stale
